content.title: Immaculate innings: 3 strikeouts on 9 pitches
content.text: Three up, three down, with all three batters struck out on three pitches each.While the "immaculate inning" isn't nearly as rare as it once was -- there were none from 1929-52 and seven alone in 2022 -- any pitcher who can plow through a big league lineup on nine straight strikes deserves a special place in the record book."I've been pitching seven or eight years, and I just [didn't] know what [an immaculate inning] is," closer Kenley Jansen said after tossing one for the Dodgers in 2017. "But now I know, and it's awesome."Here are the pitchers who have accomplished this impressive feat.• Michael Soroka, D-backs, March 30, 2026Fifth inning vs. Tigers: Javier Báez, Kerry Carpenter, Gleyber Torres• Mason Miller, Padres, Sept. 3, 2025Eighth inning vs. Orioles: Jeremiah Jackson, Ryan Mountcastle, Emmanuel Rivera Watch >• Andrew Kittredge, Cubs, Aug. 6, 2025Seventh inning vs. Reds: Austin Hays, Gavin Lux, Tyler Stephenson• Brandon Young, Orioles, July 8, 2025Fifth inning vs. Mets: Jesse Winker, Jeff McNeil, Luis Torrens• Cal Quantrill, Marlins, May 18, 2025Fourth inning vs. Rays: Jonathan Aranda, Christopher Morel, Kameron Misner• Ryan Pepiot, Rays, Sept. 18, 2024Fifth inning vs. Red Sox: Connor Wong, Wilyer Abreu, Triston Casas• Michael Kopech, White Sox, July 10, 2024Ninth inning vs. Twins: Brooks Lee, Matt Wallner, Max Kepler• Johan Oviedo, Pirates, May 24, 2023Fourth inning vs. Rangers: Jonah Heim, Robbie Grossman and Josh H.
